searchText: validator key being used for withdrawal wont lead to compromise if withdrawal is only allowed to your pre-determined address as per <@!695019898274840626> contract why are we discussing a 3rd key lol i mean here the 3rd key becomes an eth1 address but thats okay i guess? Because security is important. Users can choose to use the same key for all 3 things, or any two. no i mean whats the problem with 2 key system The idea is to *enable* security conscious users to have different levels of security for things that have different attack vectors and risks. as long as you lock-in what eth1 address withdrawals happen to (at the start of staking i mean) The amount someone can steal from you and the mechanism by which keys are accessed/stored differs between the 3 things. have you seen <@!695019898274840626> proposal Probably not. https://ethresear.ch/t/dirt-simple-withdrawal-contract/8218 basically if you pre-decide which eth1 address the withdrawals are allowed to ... then your kind of stealing is impossible <@488328812501663744> I think the issue of the validator key came to light only after @jgm proposal For transfers the only way to steal would be to compromise this eth1 address after it has been finalised oh ok Yeah, the 3rd key is specific to the proposal to allow transfers within ETH2, separate from withdraws. yeah i got your proposal im just saying this is simpler to implement if you got mine no need for a 3rd key I don't have a horse in the race, I only care that if any given proposal is implemented it provides users effective mechanisms for securing their assets. A withdraw-only proposal doesn't introduce a new risk profile, so no need for a new key for such a thing. I think one of the issues is that either <@695019898274840626> 's or <@291925846556540928>'s proposals leave open the door for congestions on both the entry and exit queue with validators just withdrawing to create new ones with 32ETH. <@144468805697929216>'s alleviates this issue by allowing excess transfer. Yeah, the basic idea is to have a mechanism for transfers that avoids users having to carry out withdrawal-as-transfer. As I noted on ethresear.ch I think there is an easy amendment to jgm's proposal that integrates it smoothly with either of mine or <@!291925846556540928>'s proposals, reduces the complexity, and adds no new capabilities to either key (nor does it require the withdrawal key to become or remain "hot"). https://ethresear.ch/t/simple-transfers-of-excess-balance/8263/5?u=technocrypto I don't think it's so trivial to integrate <@144468805697929216>'s proposal to <@291925846556540928>'s as the latter relies on the exit mechanism and uses a flag to keep a list of withdrawn validators. It's possible to implement but I think it will change the essence of the simplicity of that proposal As I noted here: https://ethresear.ch/t/simple-eth1-withdrawals-beacon-chain-centric/8256/10 I think it's necessary to include the required features in djrtwo's proposal anyways.
